systematic_findings: POST-CHECK BUG (new): initials_from_source reads World Scientific's all-caps Crossref given names as strings of initials: FreeEtal03b 'R E B E C K A', LachEtal00a 'E U G E N I O', 'M I C H E L', 'A N T O I N E', 'J A C Q U E S', CarlEtal05 'G U N N A R', 'A F R A', 'A N N E'. It also reads PubMed's suffix 'Engel, J Jr' as a second initial (BragEtal99, outside the set: 'J J Engel'). It also adds an initial that PubMed alone prints when the publisher gives a full given name without it (MeckEtal99 'A D Mecklinger'; Crossref 'Axel'). 5 of 6 applications in wave 3 are wrong; only vandEtal17 'M A A van der Meer' is right. Caused by the post-check.

POST-CHECK BUG (new): the journal-to-series move for contained types fires when the booktitle is a reworded name of the same conference, so DesaEtal12 and BoseEtal92 get a Series that repeats the Booktitle. It should drop the journal (as the NeurIPS case does), not move it. Caused by the post-check.

Researchers cannot propose removals, and no rule covers these cases: Number stays next to an article number moved into Pages (Brig12 in the set; JayaEtal23, CookEtal16, AfshEtal13 and NastEtal18 outside it, where every researcher asked for Number to be removed). @article -> @misc keeps Journal and a URL in Volume (Hint12). Not caught by the post-check.

Researcher error: FreeEtal03b takes Crossref's deposit typo 'Jorsten' for Rebecka Jörnsten (the author's own list prints 'Jornsten, R.'). The single-source surname hold keeps it from being applied, so the post-check catches it.

Noise: Bastvand05's print_year_conflict suggests 2005 from a Crossref deposit error (vol 32 = 2006, PubMed); TsodEtal96 and SimoEtal04 doi_record_conflict flags are Crossref gaps. Surname holds on correct values (BrigEtal18, Brig12, BoseEtal92 Vapnik, JohnEtal08, BurkEtal15, RuggEtal96) are the corroboration rule working as designed.
